quarterly_data.quarter: ASUS press release: ASUS Republic of Gamers Announces Availability of ROG XBOX (10-15-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: ASUS Republic of Gamers announced that the ROG XBOX Ally X20 gaming handheld is available for purchase from October 15, 2026: a 7.4-inch OLED ROG Nebula HDR Display and the AMD Ryzen AI Z2 Extreme processor, US$1,299 as a standalone device or US$2,499 bundled with the ROG XREAL R1 Edition 20 Gaming AR Glasses, a custom dbrand Killswitch case and a Pelican Protector Case. The ROG XBOX Ally and ROG XBOX Ally X remain on sale at their original MSRPs of US$599 and US$999.
quarterly_data.figure: available October 15, 2026; US$1,299 standalone; US$2,499 bundle
